settings.about.origin: Jobee'sLair was originally inspired by an open-source fork of Overdrive. It has since been redesigned from the ground up and is developed independently.

settings.guide.consoleDetail: In Storage & feeds, choose Add a feed, type the address on the on-screen keyboard and confirm. Up to {count} feeds.
settings.guide.detail: Find a catalog feed and add it from the controller or your phone
settings.guide.findDetail: A catalog feed is a JSON file whose address ends in .json, published by a source you trust. Copy its full https:// address. Add only feeds for content you have the right to download.
settings.guide.mirrorsDetail: Select a feed and choose Add a mirror (up to {count}). If the feed's own address goes down, Jobee'sLair refreshes from a mirror instead.
settings.guide.phone: Or add it from your phone
settings.guide.phoneDetail: Turn on Phone companion and choose a PIN, open {url} on a phone on the same Wi-Fi and sign in with it. In Feeds, paste the address and tap Add.
settings.guide.refreshDetail: Choose Refresh feeds in Storage & feeds, or Sync all on the phone. Each feed then shows how many games it brought, or why it failed.
settings.guide.reopenDetail: New games appear in the catalog the next time you open Jobee'sLair.
settings.legal.feeds: Feeds and mirrors you add are your own choice, fetched and read on your console. The bundled catalog is an index of titles and third-party links, not the files themselves.
settings.legal.neutral: Jobee'sLair is an open-source, user-driven download tool. It is not a content service.
settings.legal.nohost: It does not host, store, stream or distribute game binaries or other copyrighted media. None sit on a project server or in this app. Your console fetches files from third-party addresses when you start a download.
settings.legal.report: To report an infringing feed or catalog entry, send a takedown notice on GitHub naming the work, the exact address and your contact details. A complete, valid notice is acted on.
settings.sounds: Click on every move. Chime when a download finishes.
settings.statusLightDetail: Controller light shows queue state: idle breathing, green progress, amber paused, red error
settings.theme.detail: Saved for this console. The black base stays; only the accent shifts.
settings.theme.detailUser: Saved for {user}. Each PS5 profile keeps its own accent.
settings.theme.redraw: Applies to the whole interface when Settings closes.
